title: Rüstem Pasha Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Rüstem Pasha Mosque exterior: irregular raised shop/terrace base,broad hipped outer canopy,five-domed columned pointed-arch porch,coarse blue tile fields,stone hall with low side galleries and corner domes,windowed polygonal central drum,large grey metal dome and one pale single-balcony minaret. Original geometric blue/cream tile rhythm suggests Iznik surfaces without reproducing historic artwork or inscriptions. Neighbor buildings,detached courtyards and furnished interiors are excluded.
